movers.headline: secures a **200 MW turnkey order from NLC India** - approximate contract value **Rs 1,600 cr**, to be commissioned in **24 months**. A **repeat** order from the same customer, executed turnkey (supply plus balance-of-plant plus commissioning).

board approves acquiring **Mahindra & Mahindra's Truck and Bus Division (MTBD)** - employees, assets, IP, licences, contracts and liabilities - as a going concern on a **slump-sale basis** under a Business Transfer Agreement, for **Rs 525 cr cash**, subject to working-capital adjustment, valued by BDO Valuation Advisory. The BTA is to be executed on or before **7 August 2026**. The disclosure sizes the division: **FY2025-26 turnover Rs 2,989 cr on 14,832 vehicles sold**. M&M is SML Mahindra's holding company, so this is a related-party transfer of the parent's truck-and-bus business into its listed arm.

board approves **raising up to Rs 1,000 cr by QIP** (or other permissible mode), alongside Q1 FY27 results and the re-appointment of Mr Sandeep Tandon as Executive Chairman for five years from 1-Oct-2026. An approval-stage raise, not an executed one.

acquires **100% of Giskard Datatech** through cash plus a **1:31 share swap**, issuing **20,50,588 equity shares on a preferential basis for consideration other than cash** (Rs 121.57 cr); Giskard becomes a wholly owned subsidiary. Today's filing is a **revision** withdrawing a paragraph on the cash component that was inadvertently included in yesterday's outcome - the acquisition itself stands.

subscribes to **9,920 Series-A CCPS and 12,202 partly paid Series-A1 CCPS of Aidin Technologies** for **Rs 35.00 cr**, taking **31.82% of the target's paid-up capital** - continuation of the intimation dated 30-Apr-2026.

order_wins: **Inox Wind** - Rs 1,600 cr, 200 MW turnkey repeat order from NLC India, 24-month commissioning (~12.2% of mcap).
**Career Point Edutech** - Rs 35.75 cr MAHAJYOTI online-coaching work orders, Government of Maharashtra - the press release for **yesterday's** Reg-30 filing, not a fresh order.
**Shayona Engineering** (SME) - Rs 6.42 cr purchase orders, two same-day (Rs 3.53 cr + Rs 2.88 cr) (~11.7% of mcap).

**Valor Estate** (formerly D B Realty) - moves its Goa **International Convention Centre** Letter of Award forward: SPV incorporated, performance bank guarantee deposited and the **Concession Agreement executed** with the Government of Goa (value not disclosed).
**Larsen & Toubro** - an orders/contracts intimation whose filing content disagrees with the subject tag; held out of movers pending the detail.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Syrma SGS Technology** - board approves a **QIP of up to Rs 1,000 cr** (~4.0% of mcap).
**DEE Development Engineers** - listing of a further issue on a preferential basis (execution of an earlier approval).
equity_allotments: **Emkay Global Financial Services** - allotment of 1,00,000 equity shares on **conversion of warrants** (Rs 1.80 cr) - completion of past capital, never a mover.
**Devyani International** - grant of stock options under its ESOP scheme (not capital raised).
business_updates: **Results season** - 33 companies filed results / earnings-call material by 15:30 (Cartrade, Equitas, Syrma, Craftsman and others) - tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here. **The count will rise sharply after the close.**

**ACME Solar Holdings** - raises **Rs 3,404.57 cr of project funding from Power Finance Corporation** for the 250 MW **ACME Urja One FDRE** project - debt, so it is a funding milestone rather than an equity event.
**Kreon Financial Services (StuCred)** - Q1 FY27 business update, Rs 15.80 cr (~9.4% of mcap).
**Renaissance Global** - opens the **third US retail store** for Jean Dousset, in San Francisco.
**Thomas Cook (India) / SOTC** - launch premium rail experiences, expanding the international holiday portfolio.
distress_risk: **Kalpataru Projects International** - pendency of litigation / dispute with an outcome that may impact the company.
**Jagran Prakashan** - update on the board meeting (the promoter-family matter reported yesterday).
**Advance Agrolife** - clarification on price movement sought by the exchange.
other_notable: **Tips Music** - board to consider a **buyback** on 5-Aug-2026 (prior intimation).
**Pro Clb Global** - increase in authorised share capital (enabling step for the K Globes subscription above).
**Debt, dropped per §3:** ACME Solar's Rs 3,404.57 cr PFC project loan is listed above as a funding milestone, not a raise.

tally: 2026-07-29 (PARTIAL DAY - capture to 15:30 IST, before the post-close peak): 417 announcements, 116 material rows -> ~35 curated lines. The structural event of the day is **Mahindra & Mahindra transferring its Truck and Bus Division to SML Mahindra on a slump sale for Rs 525 cr** - the filing sizes MTBD at **Rs 2,989 cr of FY26 turnover on 14,832 vehicles**, which is the first hard number we hold on that division. The largest order is **Inox Wind's Rs 1,600 cr / 200 MW NLC India repeat turnkey** (~12% of mcap); the largest raise is **Syrma's Rs 1,000 cr QIP approval**. **5Paisa** buys Giskard Datatech outright (cash + 1:31 swap) and **Indo-National** takes 31.82% of Aidin Technologies. Held out: Career Point's Rs 35.75 cr is yesterday's MAHAJYOTI order re-announced as a press release, Pro Clb's Rs 30 cr is 210% of its market cap, and ACME's Rs 3,404 cr is project debt. Note the store had to be re-enriched before this digest: the 13:46 cycle resolved only 134 of 417 tickers because the security-master maps were unavailable for that run, which had silently emptied the mover list.
